therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: mood stabilization via dopaminergic and serotonergic modulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with manic or mixed episode associated with bipolar I disorder
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline to endpoint in YMRS total score (olanzapine monotherapy arm); response, remission, and relapse rates

results.effect_size: YMRS mean change -3.0 (95% CI: -4.10 to -1.90); 97 participants with manic response; 93 with remission of mania; 3 with relapse of manic symptoms
biomarker_changes: High triglycerides (≥500 mg/dL): 5/100 olanzapine monotherapy, 2/38 olanzapine+mood stabilizer
High fasting glucose: 3/40 olanzapine monotherapy, 0/6 olanzapine+mood stabilizer
High LDL: 24/71 olanzapine monotherapy, 11/31 olanzapine+mood stabilizer
Low HDL: 10/93 olanzapine monotherapy, 3/36 olanzapine+mood stabilizer
High HbA1c: 2/97 olanzapine monotherapy, 0/38 olanzapine+mood stabilizer
Weight increase ≥7%: 17 olanzapine monotherapy, 10 olanzapine+mood stabilizer
DIEPSS maximum change from baseline: 0.05 olanzapine monotherapy, 0.64 olanzapine+mood stabilizer
subgroup_findings: YMRS change from baseline to endpoint in olanzapine+mood stabilizer arm: -19.8 (95% CI: -25.58 to -14.06)
CGI-BP overall severity improved from 4.7 to 2.9 in olanzapine+mood stabilizer arm over 18 weeks
CGI-BP overall severity remained stable ~1.7-1.9 in olanzapine monotherapy arm (already low at baseline)
54 participants achieved remission of bipolar disorder at week 18 in monotherapy arm; 12 in combination arm
Switch to syndromic depression: 8 monotherapy, 4 combination
Switch to symptomatic depression (HAMD-17 ≥13): 4 monotherapy, 1 combination
safety_signals: No clinically significant QTcF prolongation in either arm
Weight gain ≥7% observed in 17 monotherapy and 10 combination participants
Low systolic blood pressure in 6 monotherapy and 2 combination participants

dose_info.dose_modifications: Lithium, valproate, and carbamazepine doses adjusted according to local package insert

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Lithium's GSK-3 and inositol pathway inhibition complements olanzapine's dopaminergic blockade, producing additive mood-stabilizing effects beyond olanzapine monotherapy
modulation_entries.citation: Change From Baseline to Endpoint on the YMRS Total Score - Olanzapine + Mood Stabilizer Only: mean difference -19.8 (95% CI: -25.58 to -14.06) vs olanzapine monotherapy -3.0 (95% CI: -4.10 to -1.90)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Valproate's GABAergic enhancement and histone deacetylase inhibition augments olanzapine's antipsychotic and antimanic effects, producing greater YMRS reduction in the combination arm
modulation_entries.citation: Change From Baseline to Endpoint on the YMRS Total Score - Olanzapine + Mood Stabilizer Only: mean difference -19.8 (95% CI: -25.58 to -14.06) vs olanzapine monotherapy -3.0 (95% CI: -4.10 to -1.90)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Carbamazepine's sodium channel blockade and neuronal membrane stabilization complements olanzapine's receptor antagonism, contributing to the greater antimanic effect seen in the combination arm
